product_overview: A blog platform where visitors can browse and read published articles, while registered users can manage their profile, create and manage their own posts, and interact with article comments. Admin users can additionally manage all articles, categories, and notifications.
core_goals: Browse published articles by category or keyword
Read full article content and interact with posts through likes and comments
Register for an account and log in to access user features
Manage a personal profile and update account password
Create, edit, draft, publish, and delete personal articles
Administer articles, categories, notifications, and admin account settings

features.name: User Registration
features.description: Create a new account with a name, username, email, and password, then continue to a registration confirmation screen.
user_flows: Navigate to /signup -> Fill in name, username, email, and password -> Submit the registration form -> See a registration success confirmation page
Navigate to /signup -> Fill in name, username, email, and password -> Submit the registration form -> See an error message that the email or username is already taken

features.name: User Login
features.description: Sign in with an email or username and password to access authenticated features.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill in email or username -> Fill in password -> Submit the login form -> See the authenticated session start
Navigate to /login -> Fill in email or username -> Fill in password -> Submit the login form -> See an error message for invalid credentials

features.name: Browse and Search Articles
features.description: View the home feed of published articles, narrow results by category or keyword, and open an article to read it in full.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Browse published articles -> Select a category tab -> See the article list update to match the selected category
Navigate to / -> Browse published articles -> Enter a keyword in search -> See the article list update to match the search term
Navigate to / -> Browse published articles -> Use pagination controls -> See more articles load on the page
Navigate to / -> Browse published articles -> Open an article card -> See the full article detail page

features.name: Read Article Detail
features.description: Read a full article, view author information, like the post, and add comments when signed in.
user_flows: Navigate to /post/:id -> Read the full article content -> View the author information -> Like the article
Navigate to /post/:id -> Read the full article content -> Type a comment -> Submit the comment -> See the comment appear in the discussion
Navigate to /post/:id -> Try to type and submit a comment while logged out -> See a prompt to log in first

features.name: Profile Management
features.description: Edit the logged-in user's name, username, and avatar, while viewing the masked email as read-only.
user_flows: Navigate to /profile -> Review the current profile details -> Edit the name, username, or avatar -> Save the changes -> See the updated profile information
Navigate to /profile -> Edit the username -> Save the changes -> See an error message that the username is already taken

features.name: Reset Password
features.description: Change the logged-in user's password by confirming the current password and entering a new password.
user_flows: Navigate to /reset-password -> Enter the current password -> Enter the new password and confirm it -> Submit the password change -> See the password update complete
Navigate to /reset-password -> Enter the current password -> Enter mismatched new passwords -> Submit the password change -> See an error message that the passwords do not match
Navigate to /reset-password -> Enter an incorrect current password -> Submit the password change -> See an error message that the current password is incorrect

features.name: Create Article
features.description: Create a new article with title, description, content, category, image, and draft or published status.
user_flows: Navigate to /my-articles/new -> Fill in the title, description, content, category, and image -> Save the article as a draft -> See the article saved in draft state
Navigate to /my-articles/new -> Fill in the title, description, content, category, and image -> Publish the article -> See the article published
Navigate to /my-articles/new -> Leave required fields incomplete or use invalid publishable content -> Submit the form -> See validation feedback

features.name: Edit / Manage Articles
features.description: View your article list, open an article for editing, update its content, or delete it from the list.
user_flows: Navigate to /my-articles -> View your article list -> Open an article for editing -> Change the article details -> Save the updates -> See the article list reflect the changes
Navigate to /my-articles -> View your article list -> Open an article for editing -> Delete the article -> Confirm the deletion -> See the article removed from the list

features.name: Category Management (Admin)
features.description: Create, edit, and delete article categories from the admin category management area.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/categories -> Create a new category -> Save it -> See the new category appear in the list
Navigate to /admin/categories -> Select an existing category -> Edit its name -> Save the changes -> See the category list update
Navigate to /admin/categories -> Delete a category -> Confirm the deletion -> See the category removed from the list
Navigate to /admin/categories -> Delete a category that is still used by posts -> See an error message

features.name: Notifications
features.description: View comment-related notifications for the user's articles, check unread counts, and mark notifications as read.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/notifications -> View the notification feed -> See the unread count badge
Navigate to /admin/notifications -> Open the notification area -> Mark all notifications as read -> See the unread count clear

routes.description: Home page listing published articles with hero, category filter, and search
Full article view with content, author card, likes, and comments
User login with email/username and password
Confirmation page shown after successful signup
Logged-in user's profile edit page (name, username, avatar)
Change password for the logged-in user
List of the logged-in user's own articles (draft and published)
Create a new article as a regular logged-in user
Edit one of the logged-in user's own articles
Admin view of all articles across all users

known_limitations.issue: Admin and regular-user "my articles" flows share the same page components (ArticleManagementPage, CreateArticlePage, EditArticlePage), differing only by route/context
known_limitations.impact: A test that assumes separate admin vs. user components may misclassify coverage
Vulnerable to XSS-based token theft; also means login state is not shared across browser profiles/incognito

known_limitations.issue: Publishing an article requires content to contain "## N. " style markdown headings, enforced only server-side
known_limitations.impact: Frontend does not pre-validate this before submit, so publish can fail with a generic-looking 400 the user may not understand
